description: Use this when the user asks to get Launchpad content-gap statistics. Returns only data visible to the linked Market Brew account.

query.description: Optional filters: customerId, websiteIds (comma-separated numeric IDs; mutually exclusive with websiteId/serverHost), websiteId or serverHost. Omit website selectors for all authorized websites in the customer context.

name: get_launchpad_stats
title: Get Launchpad content-gap statistics
